title: Memory Card Game
description: Build a memory card matching game — create a shuffled grid of cards, flip them, match pairs, and track your moves until you win.

steps.title: Create the card grid
steps.description: Define an array of card objects with `id`, `symbol`, `isFlipped`, and `isMatched` fields. Shuffle the cards and log the grid.
hints: Create pairs: each symbol should appear twice for matching
Each card: { id: 1, symbol: 'A', isFlipped: false, isMatched: false }
Use a shuffle function (Fisher-Yates) to randomize the array order
Log the shuffled symbols to see the grid layout

verification.successMessage: Card grid created with shuffled pairs!
verification.failureMessage: Make sure you create 8 cards (2 per symbol) and shuffle the array.

steps.title: Flip a card
steps.description: Write a `flipCard` function that takes a card `id`, sets `isFlipped` to `true`, and logs the card's symbol and flipped state.
hints: Find the card by id using .find()
Only flip if the card is not already matched
Set card.isFlipped = true, then log the card's symbol and state

verification.successMessage: Cards can be flipped and show their symbol!
verification.failureMessage: flipCard should set isFlipped to true and log the card's symbol.

steps.title: Match two cards
steps.description: Write a `checkMatch` function that takes two card ids, compares their symbols, and logs `"Match!"` if they match or `"No match"` if not. Set `isMatched` on matching pairs.
hints: Find both cards by their ids
If matched, set both cards' isMatched to true and log 'Match!'
If not matched, flip them back (isFlipped = false) and log 'No match'

verification.successMessage: Matching logic works — pairs are detected and non-matches are rejected!
verification.failureMessage: checkMatch(0, 2) should find both have symbol 'A' and return 'Match!'. checkMatch(0, 1) should return 'No match'.

steps.title: Track moves and timer
steps.description: Create a `moves` counter and a `makeMove` function that increments it and logs the current move count. Also track the start time and log elapsed seconds.
hints: Declare a `let moves = 0` variable outside the function
Increment moves by 1 each time makeMove is called
Use Date.now() to track start time and calculate elapsed seconds

verification.successMessage: Moves are tracked with elapsed time!
verification.failureMessage: Each call to makeMove should increment the counter. After 3 calls, the output should show 'Move 3'.

steps.title: Detect a win
steps.description: Write a `checkWin` function that returns `true` when all cards have `isMatched: true`. Log `"You won!"` with the total moves when the game is complete.
hints: Check if every card has isMatched: true using .every()
If all matched, log 'You won!' along with the total moves
Return true if the game is won, false otherwise

verification.successMessage: Win detection works! The game knows when all pairs are matched.
verification.failureMessage: checkWin should use .every() to verify all cards have isMatched: true, then log 'You won!' and return true.
